requirements.text: Publish a strict operator-shipped datatype policy with explicit supported datatype and lexical-space mappings.
Validate every reasoning-visible normalized RDF literal against the policy before OWL reasoning.
Use deterministic bounded multi-core validation whose failure result is independent of worker scheduling.
Bind the HermiT request and report to the exact datatype-policy bytes by SHA-256.
Reject merged OWL ontologies that use datatypes outside the supported operator policy.
Inventory datatype policy and validation evidence in each newly compiled immutable snapshot.
Provide Draft 2020-12 schema, fixtures, independent validation, documentation and cumulative gates without enabling OWL Direct completeness claims.
